answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake in onyx-backed collateral before it may trade, so creating thousands of hollow sock-puppet accounts costs real capital instead of nothing. Reputation then grows only through verified completed work, like fruit ripening slowly in an orchard, and misbehavior slashes the stake. An attacker must pay per identity and loses the bond when caught, making fake scale unprofitable.
